0.original: Aedoc of Quarrymill has a culinary crisis on her hands.

1.original: Aedoc has exhausted her supply of Mun<hex:021F0103>Tuy sauce, and she fears an alarming drop in morale if her culinary creations are made without the savory condiment. Make for the Mun<hex:021F0103>Tuy Cellars and obtain a bottle from Masher Erimmont.

2.original: Erimmont informs you that the next batch of Mun<hex:021F0103>Tuy sauce will finish fermenting in a short while. Whether or not it will be ready in time to save Aedoc from being devoured by famished, bean-crazed soldiers remains to be seen...

48.original: You couldn't have come at a better time, friend. I've a crisis on my hands here! What manner of crisis, you ask? Do you see this bottle of Mun<hex:021F0103>Tuy sauce? It's <hex:021A020203>empty<hex:021A020103>, down to the last drop!

49.original: Of <hex:021A020203>course<hex:021A020103> it's a crisis! Why, if our guards find their supper wanting for flavor, they're like as not to turn their lances on me instead of our foes! Might you travel to the Mun<hex:021F0103>Tuy Cellars and obtain some from Masher Erimmont to save a poor culinarian from this dire fate?

50.original: Aedoc's exhausted her supply again, has she? <sigh> Told the woman time and again to order in bulk, I did, but she never listens. Hold your chocobos, friend─the next batch'll be ready afore long.
